newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Orlando doesn't know why stock active.
newsitem.headline: Orlando doesn't know why stock active.

text.p: Orlando Holdings Bhd said on Monday it was not aware of reasons for the active trading of its stock.
In reply to a statement to a Kuala Lumpur Stock exchange query, the maker of men's apparel said there was no material development in the company's business not previously disclosed.
The stock jumped 25 percent or 5.0 ringgit to 25.00 ringgit on Monday, prompting the exchange to place restrictions on its trading.

The exchange said the sale of Orlando stock is prohibited unless a seller has the company's shares in its stockbroking account. Buyers would have to pay for the shares immediately to the stockbroking house upon acquiring them.
